established: Each ordinal re-queries aim; failed/zero coordinates skip only that missile. Allocation failure does not stop later ordinals or change successful do17 return.

Charged-bolt initialization uses aimX+ordinal seed, clamps total/current frames at77 and calls the full distance setter after uint8 conversion. Source range98 gives77 total frames and77 path distance.
limits: Progressive missile selection, skill formula, target lookup, allocation and actual path building are explicit checked services.
No modern executable timing/target, actual world missile or collision/damage integration is established; range256 is an explicit non-gameplay clamp control.
